implementation: Exact existing independent PCE package; no model edits or new implementation revision.

resources.input: same first native VAL expression, original deterministic nonaugmented loader
resources.memory: matched full predict allocated/reserved peak; full optimizer peak unknown
resources.threshold: Default total counted FLOPs<=10G; original memory/Pareto constraint unchanged
resources.accuracy: No validation accuracy evaluation or selection; resource sample only

controls.input: Same two fixed TRAIN scenes/eight expressions as prior native capture
controls.source: Actual native loss then original full hierarchy-bank/encoder recomputation, NOT frozen-bank replacement.
controls.repeat: Three exact encoder recomputations with unchanged inputs/memberships/dtype
controls.permutation: Reverse valid SP rows, inverse-map contact edges and first-level membership rows; recompute all banks/full encoder and restore rows.
controls.negative: Delete all contacts, compare original verified parent gather with fresh full bank recomputation.
controls.limits: Not whole-model SP renumbering/FPS-equivariance. Preserve failed controls; no threshold/precision/operator waiver.
controls.decision: No admission from frozen-bank controls or efficacy from untrained readouts.
